chunks: And those they used to worship will leave them in the lurch, and they will realise there is no escape for them.
ai.seo_question: What happens to false idols and deities on the Day of Judgment according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the ultimate futility of idolatry, illustrating how the false gods worshipped in life become silent witnesses to their owners' ruin. It emphasizes the psychological shock of the disbelievers as they realize that their fabricated protections offer no escape from the inevitable divine reckoning.
